data.name: Fateh
data.long_meaning: One who opens the way or conquers. Derived from the Arabic root fatha, meaning 'to open'.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name that symbolizes spiritual victory and triumph over adversity.
data.numerology_meaning: You possess a great deal of talent and creativity. Your number 3 suggests that you have a project or goal that needs your full attention and dedication. You may be required to show leadership in order to accomplish this goal.

in_arabic.name: فاتح
in_arabic.meaning: فاتح تعني الفتح والنصر والتمكين من الله
in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم فاتح مشتق من الفاتح، الفتح هو النصر والتمكين، ويسمى الله عز وجل في القرآن الكريم بالفاتح، ويعني اسم فاتح في اللغة العربية الفتح والنصر والفلاح

in_urdu.name: فاتح
in_urdu.meaning: فاتح کا مطلب فتح اور فتحیاب ہونے کی خوش قسمتی
in_urdu.long_meaning: فاتح نام عربی زبان کے الفاظ فتح سے ماخوذ ہے، جس کا مطلب ہے فتح یا فتحیاب ہونا، یہ نام اسلامی تقویم میں خاص اہمیت رکھتا ہے کیونکہ فتح مکہ کے بعد رسول اللہ صلی اللہ علیہ وسلم نے اسے استعمال کیا

in_hindi.name: फ़ातेह
in_hindi.meaning: फ़ातेह का अर्थ है विजय प्राप्त करना या सफलता
in_hindi.long_meaning: फ़ातेह नाम अरबी भाषा से लिया गया है, जिसका अर्थ है विजय या सफलता, यह नाम इस्लामी परंपरा में बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है और अक्सर उन बच्चों को दिया जाता है जो सफल और विजयी हों

in_pashto.name: فاتح
in_pashto.meaning: فاتح د فتح او بريا راوي معني
in_pashto.long_meaning: د فاتح نوم د عربي ژبې د فتح کلمې څخه اخيستل شوی، چې د فتح يا بريا راوي معنی ورکوي، دا نوم د افغانانو او پښتنو لپاره ډیر اهمیت لري

in_english.name: Fateh
in_english.meaning: Fateh means victory, conquest, or success
in_english.long_meaning: The name Fateh is derived from the Arabic root 'F-T-Ĥ', which means 'to open' or 'to conquer', it is associated with the concept of victory and success in Islam, often given to children born into families who value achievement and triumph

pronunciation.urdu: اردو میں تلفظ کی تفصیل فاتح (Fateh) کا تلفظ فاہ-تہ
pronunciation.hindi: हिन्दी में उच्चारण विवरण फ़ातेह (Fateh) का उच्चारण फा-तेह
pronunciation.pashto: په پښتو کې د تلفظ تفصیل فاتح (Fateh) د فا-تح په تلفظ

data.cultural_impact: The name "Fateh" holds historical significance and is culturally recognized as a symbol of triumph, victory, and conquering challenges. It's a name that inspires determination and draws strength from the achievements of those who bore the name in history. In Islamic context, it's linked to the idea of spreading literacy, knowledge, and faith, as evident during the early Islamic conquests when the doors to new lands and cultures were being opened.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name "Fateh" signifies inner and outer triumph and victory over one's self and the challenges in life. It represents the ability to conquer one's ego and desires and open up to the light of divine guidance. The name calls upon the bearer to be steadfast in their faith and persevere through life's challenges with courage and determination, ultimately leading to spiritual growth and enlightenment.

historical_references.reference: Fateh was the title of several Islamic rulers, including Fateh Ali Shah Qajar of Iran (1772-1834) and Fateh Muhammad Khan Nizam of Hyderabad (1750-1803).
historical_references.context: Fateh was a title given to Islamic rulers, signifying victory and conquest.
